subsystems.title: Contracts, Identity & Traceability
subsystems.scientific_summary: Defines immutable identities, status semantics, checksums, and evidence boundaries used by every scientific stage.
subsystems.developer_summary: Owns versioned schemas, typed validation, content-addressed identifiers, and source-trace utilities.

subsystems.title: Catalogue & Sequence Identity
subsystems.scientific_summary: Imports the trusted protein catalogue and preserves sequence-equivalence groups and compatible loci.
subsystems.developer_summary: Parses annotation/proteome sources and materialises canonical catalogue records and sequence-derived mass.

subsystems.title: Crystallography & Dataset Selection
subsystems.scientific_summary: Selects and reviews diffraction observations, symmetry, resolution, anisotropy, Patterson evidence, and Free-R identity.
subsystems.developer_summary: Validates MTZ inputs and propagates the selected observations and exact Free-R identity into downstream execution records.

subsystems.title: Databases & Provider Discovery
subsystems.scientific_summary: Searches bounded structural-model providers while retaining hits, no-hits, mapping gaps, and provider limitations.
subsystems.developer_summary: Coordinates database manifests, MMseqs2/Foldseek batches, provider plans, login staging, and offline packages.

subsystems.title: Localisation & Gel Evidence
subsystems.scientific_summary: Uses localisation, membrane-topology, and gel evidence to order search waves without fabricating missing observations.
subsystems.developer_summary: Validates offline PSORTb/DeepTMHMM bundles, neutral gel contracts, wave policy, and deterministic reopen plans.

subsystems.title: Model Registry & Preparation
subsystems.scientific_summary: Keeps all eligible coordinate hypotheses distinct from the capped search set and records model uncertainty.
subsystems.developer_summary: Builds predicted and experimental model registries, coordinate ownership, preparation outputs, and uncertainty bindings.

subsystems.title: Candidate Ranking & Matthews Priors
subsystems.scientific_summary: Combines catalogue evidence, model quality, localisation, gel observations, and Matthews plausibility without treating rank as proof.
subsystems.developer_summary: Constructs deterministic funnels, candidate inventories, copy hypotheses, and retained/deferred reasons.

subsystems.title: Molecular Replacement
subsystems.scientific_summary: Runs first-copy, fixed-component, and additional-copy Phaser searches while preserving raw placement evidence and no-claim boundaries.
subsystems.developer_summary: Builds exact Phaser commands, per-placement inventories, component partitions, typed outcomes, and owned attempt directories.

subsystems.title: Refinement, Maps & Sequence Assessment
subsystems.scientific_summary: Refines retained states, validates Rwork/Rfree and maps, and narrows sequence identity only when evidence supports it.
subsystems.developer_summary: Stages finalists and executes bounded refinement, map production, sequence mapping, and result validation.

subsystems.title: Multi-component Composition Search
subsystems.scientific_summary: Expands reviewed states through bounded A+B+C+… hypotheses while keeping deeper unvalidated compositions provisional.
subsystems.developer_summary: Implements beam planning, attempt fan-out, depth/global budgets, parent-state retention, and no-A expansion.

subsystems.title: Human Review & Reporting
subsystems.scientific_summary: Requires file-based decisions at crystallographic, seed, composition, and sequence checkpoints and derives honest final statuses.
subsystems.developer_summary: Owns review packages, decision validation, report derivation, resource summaries, and portable result assembly.

subsystems.title: Execution, HPC & Caching
subsystems.scientific_summary: Runs immutable source-bound workflows with complete resource, retry, cache, and checksum evidence.
subsystems.developer_summary: Owns Nextflow orchestration, reviewed HPC transport, Slurm profiles, cache replay, collection, and failure classification.

subsystems.title: Validation & Evidence
subsystems.scientific_summary: Exercises known controls, robustness/leakage checks, operational probes, and release evidence without entering normal analyses.
subsystems.developer_summary: Contains internal controls, fixtures, validation workflows, structural checks, and release-blocking evidence gates.
